title: Korean Ssam
description: A simple Korean dish featuring marinated beef wrapped in a leafy green.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the chili flakes, brown sugar, and a pinch of salt.
Add the sliced beef to the marinade and let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, heat a tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they're tender and lightly browned.
To assemble the ssam, place a lettuce leaf on a flat surface.
Add a few slices of the grilled beef and some of the sautéed mushrooms.
